subject: Ledger rewrite request — duplicate metering on Nov invoice / refund routing
body:
-----Original Message-----
From: Velox Health <finance@veloxhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Overcharge on November invoice (duplicate metering) — invoice 1123 attached

Hi Grace,

We found what looks like duplicated metering for two large jobs in the Nov invoice (Invoice #1123, attached). Line items 5–6 appear to be the same run reported twice. Total overcharge is 12,348.75 EUR. Can you confirm receipt of the invoice and advise next steps for a reversal or refund?

Also need to confirm VAT treatment — Velox is VAT-registered in Spain (ESX12345678). If you need a certificate or proof of exemption, let us know and we’ll provide it.

Attached: Velox_Nov2026_Invoice_1123.pdf

Thanks,
Luis Martinez
Head of Finance, Velox Health
finance@veloxhealth.com

---
Reply from Grace O'Connor (Grace to Velox)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
To: Velox Health <finance@veloxhealth.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Overcharge on November invoice (duplicate metering) — invoice 1123 attached

Hi Luis — thanks for flagging and for the quick detail. I’ve started an internal review and looped in our billing team (Rachel).

Plan of action (provisional):
- I will place Invoice 1123 on collection hold (no outstanding collections while we investigate).
- If the audit confirms duplicated metering, we will issue a provisional ledger rewrite: a service concession credit for 12,348.75 EUR applied against the Nov invoice while we finalize the credit memo.
- To route the refund/credit correctly we need your VAT certificate (if you want a VAT-exempt reissue) and preferred payment routing for any ACH/SEPA refund. If you prefer a credit memo rather than a wire, say so.

Please send the VAT cert and preferred routing and I’ll get Rachel to prepare the credit memo draft and escalation for finance approval.

Thanks — I’ll update by EOD Friday.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace@redwoodinference.com
---
Fwd: internal note to billing (Grace -> Rachel, Karthik)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 08:41:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Overcharge on November invoice (Velox) — need provisional ledger rewrite approval

Rachel / Karthik — forwarding Velox's note and invoice. Summary: appears to be duplicated metering (same job id reported twice) totalling 12,348.75 EUR. Customer has ES VAT number (they offered to send certificate).

Request: Please approve a provisional ledger rewrite/service concession so we can:
1) Place Invoice 1123 on collection hold.
2) Apply a provisional negative line (credit) for 12,348.75 EUR to Nov month close so customer-facing balance is corrected immediately.
3) Prepare the official credit memo and routing instructions once VAT evidence is received.

Notes:
- Impact to revenue recognition: nominal for now; we will reclass when finance issues the final credit memo.
- If we route as a refund (wire), need FX/bank details (customer to provide). If as credit memo, provide accounting reference to apply to next invoice.

Can you confirm approval and the ledger code to use for the concession?

Thanks,
Grace

---
Internal response from Rachel Kim (Billing Lead)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 12:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Overcharge on November invoice (Velox) — provisional ledger rewrite approved

Grace — approve provisional ledger rewrite and collection hold. Instructions below:

Decision: APPROVED (Billing Lead sign-off).
Action items for Billing Ops (assigned to Karthik):
- Create provisional negative entry: -12,348.75 EUR against Invoice 1123 (use GL code 6407–ServiceConcession). Mark as provisional pending VAT evidence.
- Put invoice status to "Hold – Under Review" in the billing system to stop dunning.
- Draft credit memo for legal/finance review and include reference to original invoice #1123.
- If customer supplies VAT certificate and requests refund, we will route as SEPA transfer to provided account and mark credit memo as refund-scheduled. Otherwise, will apply as credit memo to next invoice per customer's preference.

Karthik — confirm when provisional entry is posted and paste the billing system reference here.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Billing Lead, Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com
---
Final message from Velox (Luis) providing VAT cert and routing
From: Luis Martinez <luis.martinez@veloxhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Overcharge on November invoice (duplicate metering) — invoice 1123 attached

Hi Grace / Rachel — thanks for the quick turnaround and for placing the hold. Attached is our VAT certificate (Velox_EU_VAT_certificate.pdf). We’d like the adjustment issued as a SEPA refund to the account below rather than a credit memo.

Bank name: Banco de la Salud
IBAN: ES21 2100 0418 4502 0005 1234
BIC: ABCDESMMXXX
Account holder: Velox Health S.A.

Attached: Velox_EU_VAT_certificate.pdf

Please confirm when the provisional entry posts and the expected timeline for the SEPA refund.

Regards,
Luis Martinez
Head of Finance, Velox Health

> > Grace — approve provisional ledger rewrite and collection hold. Instructions below:
> > (internal thread)
